tools.name: ui_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the app to one of its known destinations, or to any same-origin path. No destinations are declared yet.

target.description: A known destination. Prefer this over a free href.

href.description: Same-origin path, for destinations that are not in the list.

tools.name: ui_open_demo_form
tools.description: Take the visitor to the Get a demo form and fill in what they already told you (name, work email, company, what they need). Use it for any demo, sales-call, quote or partnership request instead of only pasting the link. Never invent a field; it never submits — the visitor picks the rest and sends the form.

email.description: Work email, only if the visitor gave one.

message.description: What they need, in their words.
